name: RecallDeck
tagline: Spaced-repetition flashcards (SM-2) with decks, media, stats and import/export.
description: Learn efficiently with an Anki-style spaced-repetition system (SM-2 scheduling). Create decks and cards (with images), review what's due, track retention and streak statistics, and import/export decks as CSV/JSON. Fully offline; your study data stays local.
